title: Version history
empty: No versions yet. Kition records one when you save, after an agent edits, and every few minutes while you edit.
readFailed: Could not read this document's history.
unavailable: Not in this copy of the document
select: Choose a version to see it here.
restoredUndoable: The restore is one change: undo it like any edit.
nothingToRestore: The document is already like this version.

store.readOnlyTitle: Version history is read-only in this window
store.readOnlyOther: Kition on {{host}} keeps this workspace's history, so this window does not record versions. Your edits are still saved to your files.
store.readOnlySame: Another Kition window on this computer keeps this workspace's history, so this window does not record versions. Your edits are still saved to your files.
store.readOnlyUnknown: This window cannot keep this workspace's history, so it does not record versions. Your edits are still saved to your files.
store.writable: This window now keeps the workspace's version history.
